name: Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF) grants
summary: CEPF funds civil society organisations working on biodiversity conservation inside the biodiversity hotspots where it currently invests, through small and large grants awarded only via hotspot-specific calls for letters of inquiry.

geography.label: Biodiversity hotspots where CEPF currently works

reporting: Large-grant holders file financial reports every quarter and progress reports every six months through CEPF’s online system.

applicant_types.quote: We support civil society organizations of all sizes-from farmers' cooperatives and community groups to universities and international nongovernmental organizations.

geography.quote: To be considered for CEPF funding, a project must be located within a biodiversity hotspot where CEPF currently works (check the map).

access.quote: Successful applicants for small grants will sign a grant agreement with the RIT for the hotspot.

window.quote: For each call, we accept letters of inquiry for approximately six weeks.

reporting.quote: Recipients of large grants must submit financial reports each quarter and progress reports every six months through ConservationGrants.
